# Lifewise

> > Lifewise is an Auckland-based social development organization working to improve freedom, choice, and equity across Aotearoa through housing, family support, and community services.

Lifewise operates programs including Housing First for chronic homelessness, Mana Whānau parenting support, Merge Cafe social enterprise, and youth services. The organization partners with Oranga Tamariki and operates across Auckland, Rotorua, and wider New Zealand, grounded in Te Tiriti principles.

## Key Topics

- Housing First
- Mana Whānau

## Core Services & Programs

- [Lifewise NZ - Improve Freedom, Choice, & Equity in Aotearoa](https://www.lifewise.org.nz): Auckland-based social development org helping people in hardship
- [Parenting Guidance & Support NZ - Mana Whānau Programme](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/our-services/family-services/mana-whanau): 6-month intensive parenting support program with Oranga Tamariki
- [Family Services: Parenting Courses and Support for Families](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/our-services/family-services): Parenting courses and family support in West Auckland
- [Parenting Guidance & Support NZ - Mana Whānau Programme](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/parenting-guidance-mana-whanau): Mana Whānau parenting support program to keep families together

## Housing & Homelessness Solutions

- [Ending homelessness with wraparound support](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/wraparound-support): Housing First wraparound support model for ending homelessness
- [The homeless don't need coins, they need change](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/rupal-bso2016): Big Sleepout 2016 campaign promoting Housing First solutions
- [Auckland Conversations: Homelessness in Auckland](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/auckland-conversations-homelessness-in-auckland): Auckland Council forum on Housing First ending chronic homelessness
- [Lifewise Street Reach - COVID-19 lockdown](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/street-reach): Street Reach COVID-19 lockdown support for vulnerable populations

## Youth & Mental Health Services

- [5 Reasons To Raise The Leaving Age to 21](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/5-reasons-to-raise-the-leaving-age-to-21): Advocacy piece on raising care leaving age to 21 for youth
- [Help rangatahi receive mental health and addiction support](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/urgent-call-to-help-rangatahi): Fundraising appeal for $45k for rangatahi mental health services

## Community Programs & Social Enterprise

- ["It's helped me to find myself again." • Lifewise Merge Cafe](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/merge-cafe-find-myself): Merge Cafe volunteer testimonial on community and healthy meals
- [Next Steps: the Piki Project](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/next-steps-piki-project): Merge Community Piki Project art initiative with paper feathers
- [My first pounamu and taonga • Lifewise Rotorua](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/my-first-pounamu): Rotorua residents design pounamu taonga preserving mana and mauri

## Fundraising & Campaigns

- [You can turn a life around this Mother's Day](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/mother-s-day): Mother's Day campaign for Mana Whānau and Housing First programs
- [Scott Coldham and Paul Wilson rough it for a good cause](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/stop-press): Big Sleepout fundraising event coverage with Scott Coldham and Paul Wilson
- [You can make this a happy Christmas for everyone!](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/a-happy-christmas-for-everyone): Christmas donation campaign for Housing First and family services
- [Good news, thank you's and much more!](https://www.lifewise.org.nz/good-news-and-thank-yous): Newsletter update on Lifewise programs and COVID-19 response
